scope: Representative broadleaf, pine and rock independently reimported FBX files; UE import uses normals and tangents with full precision UVs. No tangent-space normal texture is assigned.

samples.conclusion: Normals continuous at shared mesh vertices; visible triangle mosaic in first texture renders was chiefly UV-sampled color discontinuity.
